notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth Patch News (Ver. 1.0.4)
notes.content: [p][/p][p]The latest patch, which will update your game to "Ver. 1.0.4" is available now. This update will adjust gameplay and fix some issues. We kindly ask that you apply the latest update file before playing.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]▼Fixed Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the swordsman would not appear when entering a map containing the "Red Crystal Room" in the "Barren Volcano" area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the time displayed in the save slot was also counting during sleep mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could become buried in a wall and take damage when proceeding through certain MAZE using specific steps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable if the player touched and died simultaneously with the boss when releasing GAIA.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable without transitioning to the game over screen upon death under while in mini-pack mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where events that had already occurred in the space battleship area could reoccur under specific conditions, making the game unplayable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could become buried in a wall when caught on special terrain with ACTIV shots during the "Lord of Gluttony" battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would crash after a certain period of time if the time ran out while the player was stopped at the edge of the screen during the Withered Volcano MAZE boss battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor display fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed the HP Limit Boost equipment so that this PERK does not disappear even if the player dies.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the required aura and materials for some items that can be purchased from merchants in areas such as the " Barren Volcano."[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the aura required to level up attack power and ESP limits from LV.1 to LV.3.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the aura required to purchase emergency escape devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the aura required to obtain information.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the game to restart from the boss battle if retrying from a boss battle in a MAZE.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the initial number of lives in MAZEs in general.[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed the clear time for the MAZEs of G-Hosts: Red Bragza: Terrias-Gilba, Blue Bragza: Terrias-Juno, Pink Bragza: Terrias-Boz Rag, and Orange Bragza: Terrias-Valou.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the operation settings in mini-pack mode and whether or not to display the jump guide to be saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the behavior of some bosses.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We are looking for opportunities to improve your gameplay experience and are paying close attention to opinions and requests from players. We would be grateful if you could cooperate with the following questionnaire:[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2"]https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2[/url][/p][p][/p][p]*The questionnaire period has been extended until 23:59 on September 21st (Sunday).[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for playing Shadow Labyrinth![/p]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the swordsman would not appear when entering a map containing the "Red Crystal Room" in the "Barren Volcano" area.
Fixed an issue where the time displayed in the save slot was also counting during sleep mode.
Fixed an issue where players could become buried in a wall and take damage when proceeding through certain MAZE using specific steps.
Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable if the player touched and died simultaneously with the boss when releasing GAIA.
Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable without transitioning to the game over screen upon death under specific conditions during the "Orange Bragza: Terrias-Valou " battle.
Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable when performing specific actions in the space battleship area while in mini-pack mode.
Fixed an issue where events that had already occurred in the space battleship area could reoccur under specific conditions, making the game unplayable.
Fixed an issue where players could become buried in a wall when caught on special terrain with ACTIV shots during the "Lord of Gluttony" battle.
Fixed an issue where the game would crash after a certain period of time if the time ran out while the player was stopped at the edge of the screen during the Withered Volcano MAZE boss battle.

tags.balance_change: Changed the HP Limit Boost equipment so that this PERK does not disappear even if the player dies.
Reduced the required aura and materials for some items that can be purchased from merchants in areas such as the " Barren Volcano."
Reduced the aura required to level up attack power and ESP limits from LV.1 to LV.3.
Reduced the aura required to purchase emergency escape devices.
Reduced the aura required to obtain information.
Changed the game to restart from the boss battle if retrying from a boss battle in a MAZE.
Increased the initial number of lives in MAZEs in general.
Relaxed the clear time for the MAZEs of G-Hosts: Red Bragza: Terrias-Gilba, Blue Bragza: Terrias-Juno, Pink Bragza: Terrias-Boz Rag, and Orange Bragza: Terrias-Valou.
Changed the operation settings in mini-pack mode and whether or not to display the jump guide to be saved.
Adjusted the behavior of some bosses.

notes.title: Shadow Labyrinth – Patch News
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Greetings players, UGSF soldiers, and Swordsmen—thank you for playing Shadow Labyrinth. With the help of our continued testing and your insightful feedback we have begun work to patch-in some game updates. Our focus is to address bugs, difficulty, on-boarding, and quality-of-life to improve your play experience and better deliver on the promise of exploration and combat with PUCK at your side.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our first patch will focus on:[/p][p]·         An issue where the Swordsman may not appear when entering the “Red Crystal Room” in the "Barren Volcano” map area[/p][p]·         An issue where play time may inaccurately include sleep mode[/p][p]·         An issue where players could get stuck in walls and take damage in certain areas of MAZE.[/p][p]·         An issue where the game becomes unplayable if the Swordsman dies while touching a boss at the same time as transforming into GAIA[/p][p]·         Minor UI fixes[/p][p] [/p][p]Additional adjustments to go live later:[/p][p]·         Update the HP Limit Boost PERK to be permanent[/p][p]·         Reduce ORA and resource materials required for merchant items in the “Barren Volcano” map/area[/p][p]·         Reduce ORA required for emergency escape devices and obtaining information[/p][p]·         Add retry option to Maze stage boss battles[/p][p]·         Increase initial number of lives in Maze stages overall[/p][p]·         Address time limits for fairness for clearing Maze stages for all four G-Hosts: Red Bragza: Terrias-Gilba, Blue Bragza: Terrias-Juno, Pink Bragza: Terrias-Boz Rag, and Orange Bragza: Terrias-Valou[/p][p]·         Additional minor adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]These updates are targeting late August and early September and are intended for all platforms. We will share more details as those times draw closer. In the meantime, we are paying attention to what you have to say, please take our Shadow Labyrinth survey at the following link! (Responses accepted until September 21st.)[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2"]https://survey.bandainamcoent.co.jp/jfe/form/SV_0BUMeVvQEyWPbU2[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]For updates please follow [url="https://x.com/BandaiNamcoUS"]Bandai Namco US on X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/shadowlabyrinthgame/"]Shadow Labyrinth on Instagram[/url], and join the Shadow Labyrinth channel on the [url="http://discord.gg/pacman"]Official PAC-MAN Discord server[/url].[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]END TRANSMISSION.[/p]

notes.title: Release Date and New Gameplay Revealed!
notes.content:
[h2]We are very excited to announce that Shadow Labyrinth is coming very soon, on July 18th, and that the pre-orders are finally open! [/h2]

[h3]To let you in on more of the game's secrets, we have prepared a brand-new trailer that shows 3 different ways to play Shadow Labyrinth. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=3ntSBn35JlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This new trailer spotlights the never-before-seen gameplay where you can take on the form of a massive robotic mech called [b]GAIA[/b]. While in this form you will inflict devastating damage on enemies and level the playing field for battles with some of the game’s most epically huge bosses. 

Now you know that there are [b]3 modes[/b] of play the game: 
[olist]
[*] controlling the [b]Swordsman No.8 [/b]is all about weapon use and artfully dodging, 
[*] [b]Mini PUCK mode[/b] is all about exploring hidden and out of reach pathways, 
[*] and [b]GAIA [/b]is Shadow Labyrinth's version of a Power Pellet: a robotic giant with devastating force!
[/olist][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343429/958d7eb3630e2fdfdd50cb851a5204f5e61b2344.jpg[/img]

[h3]Full details on all available digital pre-order versions for SHADOW LABYRINTH include: 
[list]
[*] Digital Standard Edition: Includes the Base Game and Original Arcade Sound FX Pre-order bonus. 
[*] Digital Deluxe Edition: Includes the Base Game, Original Arcade Sound FX Pre-order bonus, and Digital Deluxe Content (Digital Artbook and Digital Soundtrack)
[/list][/h3]

[h3]Stay on the lookout for more secrets and surprises from Shadow Labyrinth and don't forget to preorder now and discover a new mysterious world[b] on July 18th[/b]![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859430/Shadow_Labyrinth/
